en.t: I live here alone, so it is certainly spacious.

units.source_text: 驹子虽这么说，可隔扇全都打开了，

en.t: Komako said this, but all the sliding partitions had been opened,

units.source_text: 那边房子堆满了旧家具，

en.t: and the room over there was piled full of old furniture,

units.source_text: 在被煤烟熏黑了的拉门中间铺了驹子的小铺盖，

en.t: while Komako's little bedding had been laid out among the sliding doors blackened by soot,

units.source_text: 墙上挂着赴宴的衣裳，倒像狐狸的巢穴。

en.t: and with her banquet clothes hanging on the wall, it looked rather like a fox's den.
